description: For a consistent negation-complete proof presentation \(P\), its specified total decision function returns true exactly on the codes with an accepted proof.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.decision_spec
  (P : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.ProofPresentation)
  (hc : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.Complete P)
  (hk : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.Consistent P) (n : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.decision P ⋯ n = true ↔
    Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.Provable P n
